Description

Whether you're playing casually or in a team, you'll struggle to find better cricketing facilities than London Fields in the East London area. The brilliant cricket pitches, played on grass, is one of the best places in London to play. With facilities like cricket pitches and cricket nets in London being either fully booked or not local enough, London Fields provides an excellent solution to those issues.

It is the ideal evening activity during the cricket season, whether you’re playing with friends or your team. The nature of cricket practise means you can also just turn up and join a game.

If you’re driving then it is worth noting that there are not any free parking spaces provided by the venue. There are spaces available to park your car but these are pay and display areas and are monitored.

The venue is open to the public to come and play on a one off basis. Their pay as you play system means that you can book now and play without being a member. This gives you the freedom to play a one off game without having to pay a monthly membership fee.

If a one-off game isn't enough, then why not take advantage of the block booking option at London Fields? Block bookings are a great way to guarantee a weekly game and socialise with your friends. It also takes the hassle out of paying before each game and collecting money from teammates as there is a one-time payment.

The closest station when travelling is Hackney Central. The facility is located a short walk from here - for more details on how to access the facility please contact the venue.

Those looking to book for other sports such as ultimate Frisbee can make an enquiry via the enquiry form above.
